title: Welcome to the zoo
instructions: Hayvanat bahçesinde bir anons. Uzun bir metin; saatler, yerler ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Welcome to City Zoo! Here is some information for your visit today.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: You can see the lions feed at eleven o'clock, near the main gate.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The penguins eat at two o'clock. The penguin house is next to the café.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Today the monkey house is closed, because the monkeys are getting a new home.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please do not give food to the animals. It can make them ill.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The children's farm is open from ten to four. Children can touch the rabbits and goats there.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The zoo closes at six, but the last ticket is at five.

questions.prompt: What time can visitors see the lions eat?
questions.feedback: Aslanlar saat on birde, ana kapının yanında besleniyor.
